verdict.rationale: Meltano supports scheduled pipelines orchestrated via Apache Airflow and running EL(T) pipelines via `meltano run`, enabling automations that execute without manual intervention once configured, but this is not framed as AI-native agentic automation—it's traditional data pipeline scheduling requiring an external orchestrator. missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven/agentic autonomous decision-making, native built-in scheduler (vs relying on Airflow), and any AI-native background automation framing beyond ELT scheduling.
